top_news.summary: President Donald Trump's investments in pharmaceutical companies have significantly increased after his return to the White House. A report from congressional Democrats reveals Trump's portfolio added millions of dollars in stocks from firms benefiting from a Republican-backed law that shields certain medications from Medicare price negotiations. The report was released Friday by the Joint Economic Committee’s minority arm. The report shows the Republican president's pharmaceutical stock holdings grew from $1.7 million in 2024 to as much as $56.2 million by the end of 2025. Trump has made lowering prescription drug prices a key part of his healthcare agenda. The White House denies any ethics issues and accuses Democrats of trying to fabricate them.

articles.title: Trump increased investments in drugmakers that benefited from Medicare exemptions, Democrats say - myMotherLode.com
articles.summary: President Donald Trump's investments in pharmaceutical companies have significantly increased after his return to the White House. A report from congressional Democrats reveals Trump's portfolio added millions of dollars in stocks from firms benefiting from a Republican-backed law that shields certain medications from Medicare price negotiations. The report was released Friday by the Joint Economic Committee’s minority arm. The report shows the Republican president's pharmaceutical stock holdings grew from $1.7 million in 2024 to as much as $56.2 million by the end of 2025. Trump has made lowering prescription drug prices a key part of his healthcare agenda. The White House denies any ethics issues and accuses Democrats of trying to fabricate them.
